lines.text: KFC restaurants are closing across America.
Tasty Chick'n ran eighty-four KFC and KFC Taco Bell restaurants, in ten states.
It stopped paying royalties to KFC's owner, Yum Brands, back in November twenty twenty-five.
By the time it filed for bankruptcy, it owed about fifteen point seven million dollars.
Weeks earlier, about eighty KFCs in Puerto Rico shut, after Yum cut ties with another operator.
Zoom out. KFC closed one hundred sixty-one US restaurants in twenty twenty-five.
And opened two thousand nine hundred seventy-one overseas.
